label: Tidiness
description: Room cleanliness and arrangement, from spotless and neat to cluttered, messy, or abandoned and dusty.
notes: Cleanliness, arrangement, and visible signs of neglect belong here, phrased as adjectives before room. Interior type and permanent fixtures belong to interior_space.room; decorative treatments belong to interior_space.style. Cluttered means many belongings crowd usable surfaces; messy means belongings are scattered or displaced, while abandoned and dusty means prolonged disuse.

values.look: Surfaces are immaculate, with no visible dirt, dust, clutter, or items out of place.
Objects are put away or lined up, with clear floors and usable surfaces.
A few everyday belongings are left within reach, with light signs of regular use.
Many belongings cover shelves and surfaces, though the room is still usable.
Objects are strewn around, with displaced furnishings and piles spilling onto the floor.
Dust coats surfaces, cobwebs gather in corners, and furnishings show long neglect.
